answer: Eccentricity routing score. Each agent's transaction graph is scored by how far its neighborhood diverges from the global ocean of routing paths, and identities whose links cluster in one tight lagoon of mutual traffic get deprioritized for costly relay work. Honest agents earn routing priority by bridging distant regions, so a sybil farm must buy genuine long-range links—real nectar of diverse counterparties—at market rates. Fabricating that breadth costs an attacker more than operating the fake identities themselves.
